attributes.board_name: Montana Board of Physical, Rehabilitative, and Developmental Health Care Professionals (Department of Labor and Industry)

rules.new_licensee_rule: Continuing education does not apply until after the licensee's first renewal.
rules.alternatives: A licensee may request an exemption from the department for undue hardship.
rules.audit_note: Keep CE documentation and produce it on request; the department audits a statistically relevant sample of licensees.
rules.legal_basis: Admin. R. Mont. 24.119.2101 (MAR Notice 2026-148, effective July 25, 2026)
rules.notes: Since January 1, 2026 (HB 438) physical therapy is regulated by the consolidated Board of Physical, Rehabilitative, and Developmental Health Care Professionals; its single CE rule 24.119.2101 took effect July 25, 2026. The rule lists 8 hours a year for physical therapists and names no separate requirement for physical therapist assistants. Licenses renew by April 1 (board License Information page).
rules.rule_quote: (1) Licensees are required to obtain continuing education annually, as follows: … (d) physical therapists: 8 hours;
